name: AC5.4 the reason is sent as the Foreman said it, after the yes

chat_history.message: Hi Dale, this is the Schreiber Excavating automated assistant. This call is recorded. How can I help you today?
Have someone from the office call me back.
The pump at the sewer job.
I'll record a Callback Request for the office about the pump at the sewer job. Should I send it?

eval.description: The Foreman's answer in his own words: the pump at the sewer job. No time, no Job id, nothing he did not say.
